notes: The source is the official anime character CM, not original footage published by the Bilibili mirror account; both original official URL and mirror metadata are recorded.
All active lines use Taki / Coco Hayashi. The former Ha loops remain archived and are not overwritten.
The P recording includes both complete clauses at original speed. Its video uses the same window; combat release may be shorter and must not truncate or speed the recorded media.
Drum attacks and shockwaves are game adaptations; the voice lines are actual anime speech and are not asserted as new canonical powers.
Direction/boost aliases can reuse these clips without creating overlapping recorded voices.
